title: Dhaggeeffattoonni waan hin mul'anne irraa
intro: Golgaa addunyaa mul’atu sanaa bira darbee, walga’iin dhokataan tokko dukkana keessatti walitti qabamee, sagalee waan beekan hunda mormutti harkifame. Qajeelfama dhugaa malee waggootaaf naanna’aa turan, hamma sagaleen tokko callisa naannoo isaanii isa hin mul’anne keessaa bocamee waan tokko gadi fageenyaan keessa isaaniitti sochoosutti. Halkan kana, gaaddidduu bira darbanii eenyummaa garee dhoksaa kanaa, kan jechoota waaqa waliin wal arguun isaanii akka akeekkachiisaa dhugaa ofirraa ittisuu hin dandeenyeetti gara saba isaaniitti isaan deebise akka saaxiltan affeeramtaniittu.
clues: Nuti uumama durii ti, saboota hedduu ati dubbiste dura yeroo dheeraa dura kan jirru, ta’us garuu oduu durii namaa keessatti yeroo muraasaaf waa’een keenya dubbatama.
Uumamni keenya kan kee irraa adda, elementoota waan hin mul’anne irraa kan hodhame yoo ta’u, humnoota waan idilee morman qabna.
Baroota dheeraaf qajeelfama dhugaa malee naanna’aa turre, hamma sagaleen gadi fageenyaan waan tokko sochoosu nu bira ga’utti.
Dubbii akka waan dhageenyee hin beekne, jechoota ulfaatina dubbii kamiyyuu caalaa baatanii deeman dhageenye.
Dhoksaadhaan dhihoo dhiibnee, kan keenya akka callisnu ajajnee, yeroo caqastoonni xumuraman callisnee turuu hin dandeenye.
Gara saba keenyaatti deebi’uun: ‘Yaa saba keenya Kitaabni Musee booda bu’e, waan isa dura ture kan mirkaneessu, gara dhugaatti qajeelchu dhageenyeerra’ jennee labsine.

arabic: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًۭا
verse: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone. (72:2)
